reviews.t: The best curl cream I have ever used!
reviews.x: I love this stuff with a passion. I am a white lady who's hair has only become curly in the last ten years or so. Half the time I feel like I am fighting a losing battle against my hair. A friend of mine who is African American told me to try Miss Jessie's Quick Curls. Now no other product touches my hair.

I've never had a product work so well on my hair.  I've had many compliments too.  I wash my hair, then section it to apply the Quick Curls by Miss Jessie.  I don't know how it works, but it works wonders.  I didn't know what to expect, but I'm glad I purchased the product.  I haven't been able to find it anywhere once I ran out.  The main website is SOLD OUT!  Please make another batch, PLEASE!!!!!!

reviews.t: Not for me, but I've seen it work for lots of women...
reviews.x: This product left my curly hair very heavy and greasy.  There was something in it my hair did not like.  However, on several occasions when I've asked women with beautifully defined and frizz-curls what they use - this is the answer I get.  So, I would suggest you give it a try if you've been eyeing it for a while.

I first tried this product from a sample size I received in a beauty box and loved it.  I finally gave in to my natural hair texture so I have been trying all sorts of products to figure out what works best for me.  This works great whether I air dry or use my difffuser. I apply it in my hair after my shower while it is soaking wet and I scrunch it in. I do use a good amount so that all of my hair is covered. My hair process, like most women, depends on what my plans are for the day, weekend, we

reviews.t: Best used in wet hair; Defined my curls but acted like glue in dry hair
reviews.x: I can only use this product on just washed, very wet hair, otherwise it acts like glaze and seems to mat and mesh it together.  If used in my dry hair, it leaves a cast or coating that flakes off and makes it look dull and dry.  On wet or drenched hair it performs very well, distributing evenly and leaving a well defined curl pattern that lasts for a long time. When fully dry, hair is still very soft and touchable, holding its shape.  The smell, however, is a big fat negative for me, both wet an

reviews.t: White girl with Lots of hair!!
reviews.x: Wow!!!I love this cream.I had the most frizzy,ugly hair...not anymore.I usally get a keratin treatment to control my frizz & loosen my curl.I never wear my hair straight.Please try the Quick curl if you have frizzy hair.I'ts a conditioner and styling cream in one.It reduces the volume of my hair, so it looks like you have less hair,it doesnt swell your hair like some products!!I like the ingredients. No Salts!! The price is a little high$32 it should be more like $20.

I really didn't want to waste money trying different things so I started reading tons of reviews and narrowed it down to three different products to try.  This was the first one. I have fine strands so the quick curls weighed my curls down just enough and made them extremely shin and defined for days. I will be repurchasing when mine runs out.

reviews.t: Excellent Product for Fine Curly Hair
reviews.x: Love both the texture and fresh citrusy scent - it smells just like "freshly washed hair". The texture is a bit like Tigi Catwalk Curls Rock - but without the muck (I find Tigi Catwalk to be very gooey almost an Elmer glue-like quality). This product holds and defines my curls while staying light-weight. I had it shipped all the way to Europe, which was a bit expensive (but I wanted to try it out) so I don't think I'll be using it on a regular basis, but if it were more readily available

reviews.t: Great product for fine, wavy hair
reviews.x: Love this product!  I have fine but wavy hair - after towel drying, I use a quarter sized amount and scrunch it into my wet hair and let it dry naturally.  I wouldn't consider my hair curly, more so it tames and defines my waves with just an air dry...and most importantly my hair never feels heavy, crunchy, or greasy.
I just wanted to try something different but this product did not work well on my hair.  I really like the catwalk products better.  The smell was bad.

This is my 3rd attempt to find a curl cream for my fine hair/classic curls.  I've been using this now for about 3 weeks and so far it's worked great for me.  Took me a few tries to get the correct balance, but now that I have that figured out, I'm a "happy camper"!  Leaves my hair shiny and feeling natural, not crunchy.  And because it doesn't leave my hair feeling dirty,  I can wash my hair every few days rather than everyday. Thanks Miss Jessie!!  Well, this is my second review of this

reviews.t: Amazing. It delivers every penny's worth!!!
reviews.x: I am not African-American or Caucasian with frizzy hair.  I am Asian, but with curly, salon-permed hair--it's a really great perm, but is super frizzy without the proper care (aka lots of time spent styling). So with a crazy work schedule, I really REALLY am desperate for a product that can just go in the hair while damp, and that's all that needs to be done.  All other products can get me about 75% of the way there--frizz down and smooth, good body and volume, and most of all *curl definition*-
perfect frizz free curls even in humidity! EXCELLENT product, does what is says it will do.  highly recommend!! five stars
Since going natural I've tried lots of different products.  Ms Jessie is not for me made my hair hard and crunchy

I found this product to be heavy in both my hair as well as my daughter's and not worth the cost.  Depending on your desires when purchasing it might work for others.  I found the product:  - weighs hair down - is sticky, which for us meant it clumped curls together - hair has little bounce when this is used  I do feel this was great when used as a replacement for traditional gel when there was a need to slick hair back (i.e. a ballet bun) or on bad hair days. Also it smells really good.

reviews.t: Didn't dry faster than my usual product
reviews.x: My hair is very wavy but fine and tends to frizz.  It's also not porous so it takes forever to dry.  I hoped this would give me better results and dry quicker than my usual deva curl gel & styling foam.  I was sorely disappointed.  My hair didn't look as nice as when I use the devacurl gel and didn't dry any faster.

reviews.t: Buy this! As quickly as possible!
reviews.x: Phenomenal!  OMG, I have fine curly hair, and this is amaze balls. Best curls of my life. Honestly. I've tried all the standards --Loreal Curl, DevaCurl, Kinky Curly, Curls, but I will never look back. I'm hooked on Miss Jessie's for good. My curls are soft, bouncy, full, and gorgeous! And I love the scent.

I have wanted to try this product forever. I really wanted to love this but I just didn't it made my curls look greasy and didn't allow them to bounce like they usually do I can say my frizz had a little more control. But personally I prefer Mixed chicks products

claims.text: Many reviewers love this product and say it defines curls and tames frizz, with several calling it the best curl cream they've used.
Some reviewers report negative results, including white crumbs or flaking buildup, greasy or heavy hair, and dry, hard, brittle hair.
Several reviewers note the product works best on wet or drenched hair and can act like glue or leave a coating on dry hair.
Reviewers with fine or wavy hair report it defines curls and waves without making hair feel heavy.
Some reviewers mention the product's scent positively, describing it as fresh or cinnamon-like.
